checkpoint_review: The Router was rigorous in marking 'is_present: false' for features like ear pinnae and whiskers that were not clearly visible due to resolution/wetness. This aligns with the strict visibility rule. However, the Router marked 'Males develop thick neck mane' as untestable. While sex determination is hard, the absence of a mane on the central figure (if it were a male) is a negative signal, but since we can't confirm sex, 'untestable' is acceptable. The Router correctly identified that fore/hind flippers are obscured. I agree with all verdicts.
artifact_review: The Router identified texture anomalies in the water (severity 1.5) and blur in background subjects (severity 2.0). The Perceptual Quality Auditor flagged slight compression (0.2), which is minor. The Animal Pose Auditor reported HIGH artifact risk (88% low-confidence keypoints). While the Reflector instructions warn against over-interpreting low confidence in AI images due to domain shift, the combination of extremely low confidence across ALL body regions (face, limbs, torso) suggests the model struggled to define the structure of the swimming animal, likely resulting in the 'smudged' appearance noted by the Router. I will uphold the Router's severity ratings but note that the pose auditor's data supports the presence of structural ambiguity, even if not catastrophic melting.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class 'sea lion' (logit 7.75 vs 3.05 for otter), providing high confidence in semantic alignment despite the lack of visible diagnostic features (ears/whiskers) in the raw image. 3/6 testable checkpoints passed (Fur, Body Shape, Symmetry). The failure to visually confirm ears/whiskers lowers the score, but the classifier's strong signal compensates. The image is semantically correct but visually ambiguous regarding key taxonomic features.
artifact_reasoning: Router detected water texture smudging (1.5) and background blur (2.0). Pose Auditor showed widespread low-confidence keypoints (HIGH risk), indicating structural definition issues typical of AI-generated aquatic poses where boundaries melt into the medium. Perceptual Auditor found only slight compression. The artifacts are moderate; the subject is recognizable but lacks crisp structural definition, particularly at the waterline and in the background.
key_defects: Lack of visible external ear pinnae (critical sea lion feature) due to resolution/generation softness
Smudged water-animal boundary suggesting minor fusion/melting
High pose estimation uncertainty indicating weak structural definition of limbs/body
Background subjects suffer from significant blur/loss of detail
